slicers.notes: Pinned to 2.3.1 on every platform, deliberately one version behind: 2.3.2 through the current latest (2.4.2) segfault (SIGSEGV, exit 139) in Print::apply() -> update_values_to_printer_extruders_for_multiple_filaments whenever a machine settings file and a process settings file are loaded together via --load-settings, reproduced with OrcaSlicer's own unmodified shipped presets (not an OpenFarm data issue). The crash is in shared, platform-agnostic slicing-core code with no OS-specific branches, so treat 2.3.2+ as suspect on Linux/Windows too until proven otherwise there. See docs/superpowers/plans/im-running-in-macos-cuddly-matsumoto.md for the full investigation. The project also previously moved from SoftFever/OrcaSlicer to OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer — verify the repo/org hasn't moved again before re-pinning a newer version once this regression is fixed upstream.

"version" is the maintainer-chosen display string (FR-005), not the literal upstream release tag — Bambu Studio's actual tag/asset-embedded string for this build is "02.07.01.57"; "2.7.1" is how Bambu markets it and is what users will see. The download URLs below are explicit literals and don't depend on this field matching the tag. Note: Bambu Studio 2.7.1's macOS CLI was independently confirmed during the OrcaSlicer 2.3.2 investigation to crash the same way (same shared PrusaSlicer-derived codebase) on the equivalent machine+process combination — not yet re-pinned to an older version because no working Bambu Studio version has been bisected yet; treat it as similarly suspect.
